ValidationRule.description: Personal Email Field is readonly if the record is created or updated by integration user
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.ContactValidations__c!=True, $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Integration User', $Profile.Name <> 'Data Migration',
OR( $Profile.Name = 'PEO Service', $Profile.Name = 'BPS Service', $Profile.Name = 'Contact Center', $Profile.Name = 'Retirement Services'),
OR( CreatedBy.Profile.Name = 'Integration User', LastModifiedBy.Profile.Name = 'Integration User'),
ISCHANGED( NSP_Personal_Email__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Personal Email is readonly, if the record is created or last modified by Integration User.
